records.footnote: From 2002, figures include establishments with less than 10 workers.  Prior to 2002, figures refer to establishments engaging 10 or more workers.  Data include all manufacturing establishments.  Valuation of output has been changed to basic price.  Historical manufacturing output, total output, operating cost, sales and direct exports have been revised accordingly from 1980.  Year 2025 data are preliminary estimates.  The values of fixed assets are at end of year.
